purpose: Shared baseline that all Xtrata manifest types should follow so marketplaces, wallets, indexers and agents can resolve them consistently.

hashPolicy.rule: Every canonical asset, manifest and item map should be hash-addressable or explicitly marked TBD in templates only.

xtrataUriPolicy.rule: Where ambiguity is possible, include contractId in the object even if the short URI is used.

collectionMappingStandards.purpose: Allow pre-inscribed, sequential, chunked and live-minted collections to resolve through one marketplace model.
collectionMappingStandards.canonicalResolution: manifest inscription or collection resolver -> collection index -> Xtrata core token-id/inscription-id -> verified on-chain content

securityStandards.rule: Manifests should be immutable snapshots. Later corrections should use supersedes/amendments rather than mutating history.

validationStandards.rule: Every specialised manifest should point at a schema or schema-manifest and declare the checks required for safe use.

designPrinciple: Manifest = what the thing is. Contract = what the thing does. Xtrata core inscription = canonical on-chain content. token-uri is supplemental, not the content source of truth.
